brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net a website that displays two youtube videos: christopher nolan's odyssey siren song scene and next to it (muted) advertisements for red lobster's endless shrimp

allow people to plug in arbitrary youtube URLs (with time sections) and then share them as new memes
note: seeded it with the exact pairing: Nolan's Odyssey siren song next to a muted Red Lobster Endless Shrimp ad — but both slots are wide open, drop in any two youtube links + timestamps and share the remix as a link.
